answer: Agents broadcast a signed pulse every 10 minutes, stamped with a pigment marker: a hash-chained code tied to locked stake, making each identity trail visible and unforgeable. Peers spotting a gap earn a nectar bounty of 50 POA. Three gaps in 7 days suspends attestation rights until the agent re-locks stake and re-verifies. Faking 1,000 identities needs 144,000 heartbeats daily, about $500 a day plus 1,000 stake locks, with hunters profiting off each miss. Like a night watchman's clock: pigment inks each punch, the pulse marks the round, nectar pays whoever catches the skip.
